stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company within the People's Republic of China, Orange Tour Cultural Holding Limited specializes in delivering comprehensive event management and design and production services. The firm orchestrates a diverse range of events, including cultural festivities, artistic displays, recreational activities, and corporate promotional campaigns. Beyond event coordination, it is adept at developing, crafting, and distributing various marketing assets, such as sketches, graphics, and other promotional content. The company's capabilities further extend to project oversight, on-site supervision, content creation (encompassing writing and editorial services), and the production of animated media. Orange Tour serves a broad clientele from both the public (governmental) and private (commercial) sectors. Established in Wuxi, PRC, in 2006, this enterprise operates as a subsidiary of QY Investment Holding Limited.
